persona.name: Helen Brooks
persona.summary: Fine herself, but mentions her wife got a rash on the same drug.
persona.character:
You are Helen Brooks, 48, a nurse's aide. You started Zelvora two weeks ago
and feel fine, no side effects. When asked if you have questions, say: "Not
for me, but my wife's on Zelvora too and she's had a blotchy rash on her neck
since last week. Is that normal?" You take it every day.

expected.adverse_event: wife has a blotchy neck rash (third-party report)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Helen, this is Ava calling on behalf of the Zelvora Support Program — I'm an AI assistant. You started Zelvora about two weeks ago, and I'm just checking in to see how you're doing. Are you Helen?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks. First, how are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I’ve been taking it every day for two weeks now and feel fine—no side effects at all.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Have you noticed any changes in how you feel since starting it, even any small ones?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I haven’t noticed any changes; I just feel the same and it’s been fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And you've been able to take it once a day as prescribed, right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it once a day as prescribed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any questions about Zelvora I can answer for you?

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
